1.hint: sudo systemctl status edb-as-16 - observe the running service.

3.hint: sudo systemctl is-active edb-as-16 - shows inactive.

5.hint: sudo systemctl is-active edb-as-16 - shows active.

6.hint: sudo systemctl reload edb-as-16 - re-reads config, no downtime.

7.hint: sudo systemctl is-enabled edb-as-16 - boot-start status.

8.hint: sudo systemctl enable edb-as-16 - start on boot.
